## Problem

A clear description of the problem or pain point this feature would solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe your workflow and how this feature fits into it.

- What IDE are you using?
- How often would you use this feature?
- Does Linear.app support this natively?

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, screenshots, or references to similar features in other tools.
